description: EV NIS2 Directive — Sentinel alert rules for oracle (SIEM-alert-rules)

rules.name: AI — Governance — Missing Risk Assessment
rules.description: Detects AI system operations without documented risk assessment per EU AI Act Article 9
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_gov_001", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%governance%' AND "value" > 0

rules.name: AI — Direct Prompt Injection

rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pi_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%direct%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: AI — Indirect Prompt Injection via External Data
